messages:
Elena: Quick sync: noticed confusion in the table charts when the y-axis label is just 'ms' in narrow rows. Users sometimes read it as 'models' or miss the meaning entirely on mobile. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/ux/tiny-axis-ms-ambig.png

Jon: Yep, small axis real estate causes ambiguity. Options: (1) show full 'ms' + unit icon tooltip, (2) hide axis unit in compact rows and put a unit pill in the row header, or (3) keep tiny 'ms' but add an explicit accessible name for screen readers. Thoughts?

Sam (Design): I worry about removing the unit from sighted view; people glance at rows to compare magnitude. Proposal: hybrid approach: keep a single-letter visible unit (e.g., 'ms' truncated to 'm') is risky. Better: show a condensed badge (e.g., 'ms') that collapses visually but stays readable, with an accessible tooltip. For very narrow widths, switch to the pill in the header.

Ravi (Eng): Implementation-wise, a small badge is fine. We'll need CSS that swaps layout at ~240px row width. Also we should ensure the badge is focusable and its tooltip is accessible (not just title attr). I can add aria-describedby linking to a hidden DOM node with full text.

Elena: UX nit: the unit badge needs a hover/focus state that doesn't push layout. Use absolute positioning so it overlays the chart area without shifting it. Also the badge should have a minimum hit area of 24x24 px for touch.

Sam (Design): Copy proposal for tooltip: "Unit: milliseconds (ms). Click or press Enter to open detail view." For screen-reader-only text on the row: "Series name, unit milliseconds, peak 2400 ms at 14:12 UTC."

a11y-bot: reminder: include aria-label and aria-describedby for the badge; keyboard must open the same popup as hover; ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for small text. Don't rely on color alone.

Jon: Another related issue: when axis labels are abbreviated, legend ordering becomes visually dominant. Users want to sort rows by unit in mixed-unit tables. Could we surface a tiny unit-filter control in the header that toggles to 'show only same unit'?

Sam (Design): Nice idea. Add a small filter dropdown (3 items: All, ms, %). Keep it collapsed by default. On small viewports it becomes a single icon that opens the same menu. We'll need to hide it from SR by default and expose via a label button with aria-haspopup.

Ravi (Eng): Implementation notes: header control can emit a data-attribute and renderer will group rows. We'll ensure keyboard navigation doesn't trap focus inside the dropdown; use roving tabindex. Performance: negligible.

Elena: Decision summary: 1) show a compact unit badge in rows with absolute positioning + accessible tooltip; 2) at widths <240px switch to unit pill in header; 3) add unit filter in header to let users isolate same-unit rows; 4) ensure all controls meet a11y hints from the bot. Sam, please draft the microcopy and the a11y spec. Ravi, spike the CSS swap and aria nodes. Jon, prototype the header filter behavior in the mock. Target: small prototype by next Thursday.

Ravi: On it. I'll open a PR and tag the thread.

Sam (Design): I'll update the mock and share links here when ready.

Elena: Thanks team :thumbsup:
